maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from hotel operations (Hilton San Francisco Financial District) and apartment rents, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Hotel guests and apartment tenants, mostly private consumers and businesses, pay the revenue.

serial_acquirer.reason: It owns and operates a fairly stable portfolio of apartments and a hotel interest, not a roll-up of companies.

mission_critical.reason: Hotel guests and apartment renters can change hotels or landlords easily, with only modest moving costs.
